    {"name": "multisystem_involvement", "analytical_usefulness": 0.65, "source_groundedness": 0.55, "rationale": "Reasonable axis, but several readings are questionable.     {"name": "vital_sign_abnormality_present", "analytical_usefulness": 0.7, "source_groundedness": 0.4, "rationale": "Potentially useful, but grounding is poor.     {"name": "procedure_or_intervention_performed", "analytical_usefulness": 0.85, "source_groundedness": 0.6, "rationale": "Intervention type is a strong candidate driver of duration.     {"name": "medication_initiation_or_adjustment", "analytical_usefulness": 0.85, "source_groundedness": 0.75, "rationale": "Meaningful axis; most samples grounded (adapalene/doxycycline->new; continue regimen->stopped_or_continued). But annual exam labeled new_medication_started is unsupported by the text.", "hallucination_observed": true},
    {"name": "patient_age_group", "analytical_usefulness": 0.2, "source_groundedness": 0.5, "rationale": "Largely redundant with the existing original age_group column, adding little analytical leverage. Values are also inferred where the source text rarely states age explicitly, making them uncertain.", "hallucination_observed": true},
    {"name": "visit_type", "analytical_usefulness": 0.8, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "rationale": "Follow-up vs new-problem vs preventive is a genuine, useful axis for duration and partially derivable from department/urgency but adds granularity. Sample mappings are sound and well grounded.", "hallucination_observed": false}
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.75,
  "source_groundedness": 0.65,
  "rationale": "Most added columns provide genuine clinical axes (complaint type, workup intensity, procedures, medication changes, visit type) directly relevant to explaining visit duration. Weaknesses: patient_age_group is redundant with the existing age_group column, and several columns show grounding problems where values assert specifics unsupported by or contradicting the source text (normal vitals flagged abnormal, an MRI order labeled invasive procedure, a preventive exam labeled new medication started). Grounding is acceptable but noticeably weakened by these over-confident inferences."
}
